 NIFT Admit Card 2027: Download Link, Release Date & Instructions
 NIFT Admit Card 2027 will be issued provisionally by the National Testing Agency (NTA) on the official portal at exams. nta.nic.in/niftee/. Candidates must download their NIFTEE Admit Card 2027 using their application credentials and print it on an A4-size sheet. Carrying a printed hall ticket along with a valid original photo ID and passport-size photographs to the allotted exam centre is mandatory for entry.

 NIFT Admit Card 2027:  The National Testing Agency (NTA) releases the official NIFT Admit Card 2027 for candidates appearing in the National Institute of Fashion Technology Entrance Examination (NIFTEE 2027). The hall ticket serves as an essential document granting provisional entry to designated test centres across India. Applicants seeking admission into undergraduate (B.Des, B.F.Tech) and postgraduate (M.Des, M.F.M., M.F.Tech) design programs must retrieve their e-Admit Card online prior to the test date.
 NIFT Admit Card 2027 Latest Updates
 NIFT 2027 Admit Card for Stage 1 will be released on January 4, 2027 , by the National Testing Agency (NTA). Registered candidates can download their hall ticket online via the official portal (exams.nta.ac.in/niftee) using their application number and date of birth.
 Prior to the admit card, an advance city intimation slip will be issued on December 21, 2026 . The NIFT entrance exam (Stage 1) is scheduled for January 10, 2027.

 NIFT Admit Card 2027 Download Link
 NIFT Admit Card 2027 for the NIFTEE exam will be available for download starting January 4, 2027 . Registered candidates can access their admit card online through the official NTA NIFTEE portal at exams.nta.nic.in/niftee. Log in using your application number and password to download and print a clear copy. Candidates must present the printed admit card alongside a valid photo ID at the examination center to gain entry. The download link will be provided once available on the officila website.
 How to Download the NIFT Admit Card 2027?
 Candidates must follow these steps to download the NIFTEE Admit Card 2027 from the official portal:
 Visit the official NTA NIFTEE website at exams.nta.nic.in/niftee/.
 Click on the link designated for NIFT Admit Card 2027 Download .
 Input the required credentials, including Application Number and Date of Birth.
 Submit the details to access the digital e-Admit Card on the screen.
 Review all printed details carefully to ensure accuracy.
 Print a clear copy on A4-size paper for presentation at the examination centre.
 Essential Documents to Carry on NIFT Exam Day 2027
 To gain entry into the examination hall on the NIFT Exam Date 2027, candidates must bring the following mandatory items:
 Printout of e-Admit Card: Clear printout on A4 paper along with the Self Declaration (Undertaking) downloaded from the NTA website, duly filled in.
 Passport Photographs: Two additional passport-size photographs (identical to the photo uploaded in the online application form) to be pasted on the attendance sheet at the centre.
 Authorised Original Photo ID: Valid, unexpired original photo identity proof from the following approved list:
 Aadhaar Card (with photograph) / E-Aadhaar printout
 PAN Card
 Passport
 School Identity Card
 Class 12 Board Examination Admit Card (with photograph)
 Ration Card (with photograph)
 Bank Passbook (with photograph)
 Category/PwD Certificates: PwD or PwBD certificate issued by an authorised medical authority if claiming relaxation or scribe assistance.
 Legal Name Change Proof: Marriage certificate, divorce decree, or legal name change document (if the candidate's name changed post-registration).
 Drawing Materials (CAT Candidates): Candidates appearing for the Creative Ability Test (CAT) must bring their own colouring and drawing instruments.
 Personal Utilities: One transparent water bottle. Diabetic candidates may bring sugar tablets or whole fruits (such as apples, bananas, or oranges).

 Items Strictly Prohibited Inside the NIFT Examination Centre
 Possession of unauthorised items inside the test hall is treated as Unfair Means (UFM) and may lead to cancellation of candidature and potential debarment from future exams conducted by NTA.
 Prohibited items include: 
 Textual material, printed/written notes, geometry or pencil boxes, pouches, writing pads, or log tables.
 Mobile phones, earphones, microphones, pagers, electronic pens, scanners, or DocuPens.
 Calculators, slide rules, electronic watches with calculator features, or pen drives.
 Handbags, purses, or metallic items.
 Loose or packed food items (except allowed items for diabetic candidates).
 NIFT Exam Day Rules and Guidelines
 Candidates must adhere strictly to these operational guidelines set by the NTA:
 Reporting Time: Candidates must arrive at the examination centre at least 2 hours prior to the commencement of the exam.
 Gate Closing Strictness: Late arrivals past the gate closing time will not be permitted to enter under any circumstances. Forceful entry or arguments with staff will be categorised as UFM.
 Seat Allocation: A computer node is randomly assigned to each candidate at the registration counter. Candidates must sit only at their designated seat. Unapproved seat changes risk cancellation of candidature.
 Question Paper Verification: Verify that the question paper loaded on the assigned terminal matches the opted subject specified on the admit card before beginning. Contact the invigilator immediately if there is a mismatch.
 Preservation of Documents: Keep the admit card intact, clean, and un-mutilated. Preserve the document along with the Confirmation Page and Scorecard for subsequent admission rounds.

 NIFT Admit Card 2027 FAQs
 How can I download my NIFT Admit Card 2027 if I forget my login details?
 If you forget your login credentials, visit the official portal at exams.nta.nic.in/niftee/ and use the password recovery or "Forgot Application Number" link. Follow the prompt instructions using your registered email ID or mobile number to reset your access details. What should I do if my photo or signature is blurry on the NIFTEE Admit Card 2027?
 Contact the NTA Help Desk immediately via helpline numbers (011-40759000 / 011-69227700) or email (nift@nta.ac.in). You will still be permitted to sit for the exam using the downloaded admit card, and NTA will make necessary corrections in the official record later. Can I change my allotted examination centre after the NIFT Admit Card Release Date 2027?
 No. NTA does not entertain requests for changes to exam centers, dates, or time shifts once the admit card has been generated. What are the NIFT exam timings for 2027?
 The timings depend on the programme and test. For example, the schedule lists GAT for B.Des. from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM and CAT from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM. Candidates should confirm their timings on the admit card. Have questions about your prep?
